title: Freezing and Unfreezing Unicellular Protists Using Mr Frosty Container
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gg3btyn
materials: Nalgene® Mr. Frosty® Cryo 1°C Freezing Containers
We usually keep it for 24 hours
Monitor surival rates within the next 24h

steps.title: Collect and centrifuge culture
steps.instruction: Collect the culture in a 15 mL Falcon tube and centrifuge at 1000 g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Discard supernatant and resuspend in DMSO
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 10 % DMSO growing medium, preparing a 10 mL final volume (1 mL DMSO mixed with 9 mL organism‑specific growing medium, e.g., marine broth).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 10 % DMSO growing medium (1 mL DMSO + 9 mL marine broth) to a final volume of 10 mL.

steps.title: Store resuspended cells at -80°C
steps.instruction: Aliquot the resuspended cells into cryovials and place the cryovials into a long‑term storage container at –80 °C.

steps.title: Thaw cryovials in water bath
steps.instruction: Remove cryovials from –80 °C storage, place them in a 35 °C water bath for 2–3 minutes until thawing begins, then promptly remove them from the bath.

substeps.instruction: Place cryovials in a 35 °C water bath for 2–3 minutes until thawing starts.
Remove cryovials from the water bath.

steps.title: Inoculate fresh growing medium
steps.instruction: Transfer the 1 mL thawed culture into 7 mL of fresh growing medium in a flask.

steps.title: Recover cells after thawing
steps.instruction: Incubate the inoculated flask for 2–3 days, then pellet the cells by centrifugation at 1000 g for 5 minutes and resuspend the pellet in fresh growing medium.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in fresh growing medium.
